concept: A high-contrast editorial split: a slim laptop and branching coral signal lines on the left suggest cheaper local AI; a monumental data-center corridor with a rising capital arc on the right suggests concentrated stakes. A thin vertical lime rule divides the halves.
style_notes: Use the approved dark-ink editorial atelier: near-black #071015 field, coral #FF6B57 and lime #C9F66B accents, bold uppercase condensed headline, generous negative space, no synthetic faces, and readable contrast at mobile size.
stock_direction: Use the already approved laptop and server-room stock-photo treatments from the video; preserve their source attribution in project records.
